question: 列出所有用户性别（gender）的取值及其对应的人数，按人数降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 统计 users 表中 gender 字段各取值的频次，仅返回 gender 和计数两列，不带任何过滤，按计数降序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users GROUP BY gender ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个城市（city）的用户总数和其中 VIP 用户（is_vip=1）数量，只返回 city、用户总数、VIP用户数三列，按城市名称升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 按 city 分组，计算 users 表中每城市的总用户数及其中 is_vip=1 的用户数，结果按 city 字典序升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS total_users, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_vip = 1 THEN 1 END) AS vip_users FROM users GROUP BY city ORDER BY city ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有用户等级（user_level）及其对应男性（gender='男'）和女性（gender='女'）人数，只返回 user_level、男性人数、女性人数三列，按 user_level 升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 按 user_level 分组，分别统计每等级中 gender='男' 和 gender='女' 的用户数量，结果按 user_level 字典序升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT user_level, COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = '男' THEN 1 END) AS male_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = '女' THEN 1 END) AS female_count FROM users GROUP BY user_level ORDER BY user_level ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个省份（province）的用户总数，并计算其中 VIP 用户（is_vip=1）占比（保留4位小数），只返回 province、用户总数、VIP占比三列，按用户总数降序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 按 province 分组，统计每省用户总数及 VIP 用户占比（VIP数 / 总数），占比四舍五入至小数点后4位，结果按总用户数降序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT province, COUNT(*) AS total_users, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_vip = 1 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS vip_rate FROM users GROUP BY province ORDER BY total_users DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有同时满足：城市为'广州市'、用户等级为'gold'、且为 VIP（is_vip=1）的用户姓名（user_name）和注册日期（register_date），按注册日期升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 从 users 表中筛选 city='广州市' AND user_level='gold' AND is_vip=1 的记录，返回 user_name 和 register_date 两列，按 register_date 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT user_name, register_date FROM users WHERE city = '广州市' AND user_level = 'gold' AND is_vip = 1 ORDER BY register_date ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个用户等级（user_level）下，男性与女性用户的数量比（男性数/女性数，保留4位小数），只返回 user_level 和该比值两列，要求女性数大于0，按比值降序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 按 user_level 分组，计算每等级内 male_count / female_count 比值（female_count > 0 才参与计算），比值四舍五入至4位小数，结果按比值降序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT user_level, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = '男' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = '女' THEN 1 END), 4) AS male_to_female_ratio FROM users GROUP BY user_level HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = '女' THEN 1 END) > 0 ORDER BY male_to_female_ratio DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有用户等级（user_level）和性别（gender）的组合，以及对应用户数，只返回 user_level、gender、用户数三列，按用户数降序、再按 user_level 升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 对 users 表按 user_level 和 gender 联合分组，统计各组合用户数，结果先按用户数降序、再按 user_level 字典序升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT user_level, gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users GROUP BY user_level, gender ORDER BY count DESC, user_level ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个城市（city）中，非 VIP 用户（is_vip=0）占该城市总用户的比例（保留4位小数），只返回 city 和该比例两列，按比例降序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 按 city 分组，计算每城市中 is_vip=0 用户数占该城市总用户数的比例，比例四舍五入至4位小数，结果按比例降序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT city, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_vip = 0 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS non_vip_rate FROM users GROUP BY city ORDER BY non_vip_rate DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有用户等级（user_level）中，注册日期在2025年之后（register_date > '2025-12-31'）的用户数，只返回 user_level 和该数量两列，按数量降序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 按 user_level 分组，统计每等级中 register_date > '2025-12-31' 的用户数量，结果按该数量降序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT user_level, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users WHERE register_date > '2025-12-31' GROUP BY user_level ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个省份（province）中，用户等级为'silver'或'gold'的用户总数，只返回 province 和该总数两列，按 province 名称升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 按 province 分组，统计每省中 user_level IN ('silver','gold') 的用户总数，结果按 province 字典序升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT province, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users WHERE user_level IN ('silver', 'gold') GROUP BY province ORDER BY province ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有用户注册日期所在月份（格式为'YYYY-MM'），以及当月注册的用户总数和其中VIP用户数量，按月份升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 users.register_date 的年月分组（YYYY-MM），统计每组 COUNT(*) 和 SUM(CASE WHEN is_vip=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)，结果按年月字符串升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(register_date, '%Y-%m') AS register_month, COUNT(*) AS total_users, SUM(CASE WHEN is_vip = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vip_users FROM users GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(register_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY register_month ASC;

question: 请返回每个用户等级（user_level）对应的平均注册天数距参考日2026-09-12的天数（即DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', register_date)的平均值），保留2位小数，并按用户等级升序排列。
intended_meaning: 对 users 表按 user_level 分组，计算每组中 DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', register_date) 的 AVG()，四舍五入至2位小数；结果按 user_level 字典升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT user_level, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', register_date)), 2) AS avg_days_since_register FROM users GROUP BY user_level ORDER BY user_level ASC;

question: 请列出所有注册日期在2025年及之后的用户中，不同性别与用户等级的组合（gender + user_level），以及对应组合的用户数量，按用户数量降序、再按用户等级升序、最后按性别升序排列。
intended_meaning: 筛选 register_date >= '2025-01-01' 的用户，按 gender 和 user_level 联合分组，统计 COUNT(*)；排序规则：先按数量 DESC，再按 user_level ASC，最后按 gender ASC。
reference_sql: SELECT gender, user_level, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE register_date >= '2025-01-01' GROUP BY gender, user_level ORDER BY user_count DESC, user_level ASC, gender ASC;

question: 请返回所有用户的注册年份（register_date 的 YEAR），以及该年注册的男性用户数、女性用户数、未知性别用户数（gender 为空或非'男'/'女'者计为未知），按年份升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 YEAR(register_date) 分组，分别统计 gender='男'、gender='女'、其余（含 NULL 或其他值）的用户数量；结果按年份升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT YEAR(register_date) AS register_year, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = '男' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count, SUM(CASE WHEN gender = '女' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count, SUM(CASE WHEN gender NOT IN ('男', '女') OR gender IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_count FROM users GROUP BY YEAR(register_date) ORDER BY register_year ASC;

question: 请列出注册时间最早和最晚的5位用户（按register_date升序取前5，降序取前5），返回其user_name、register_date和user_level，共10行，且全部结果按register_date升序排列。
intended_meaning: 取 register_date 最小的5条记录和最大的5条记录（不合并去重），输出 user_name、register_date、user_level；最终10行统一按 register_date 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT user_name, register_date, user_level FROM (SELECT user_name, register_date, user_level FROM users ORDER BY register_date ASC LIMIT 5 UNION ALL SELECT user_name, register_date, user_level FROM users ORDER BY register_date DESC LIMIT 5) t ORDER BY register_date ASC;

question: 请统计每个用户等级（user_level）中，注册于工作日（周一至周五）和周末（周六、周日）的用户数量，返回字段为user_level、weekday_count、weekend_count，按user_level升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 user_level 分组；用 DAYOFWEEK(register_date) 判定：2–6为工作日（周一=2），1/7为周末；分别求和；输出三列，按 user_level 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT user_level, SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(register_date) IN (2,3,4,5,6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count, SUM(CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(register_date) IN (1,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count FROM users GROUP BY user_level ORDER BY user_level ASC;

question: 请返回所有注册日期在2024年全年的用户中，各城市的用户总数和其中VIP用户占比（小数点后4位），按城市名称升序排列。
intended_meaning: 筛选 register_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' 的用户；按 city 分组；统计 COUNT(*) 和 ROUND(AVG(is_vip),4)；结果按 city 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS total_users, ROUND(AVG(is_vip), 4) AS vip_rate FROM users WHERE register_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY city ORDER BY city ASC;

question: 请列出所有用户中，注册间隔（相邻用户按register_date升序排列的差值，单位：天）大于30天的全部间隔值（即LAG(register_date)与当前register_date之差），返回该差值（正整数）和对应后一用户的user_name，最多100行，按差值降序排列。
intended_meaning: 对 users 按 register_date ASC 排序，用 LAG() 计算前一行 register_date，得到 diff = DATEDIFF(register_date, prev_date)；筛选 diff > 30；输出 diff 和当前行 user_name；最多100行，按 diff DESC。
reference_sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(register_date, prev_date) AS gap_days, user_name FROM (SELECT user_name, register_date, LAG(register_date) OVER (ORDER BY register_date ASC) AS prev_date FROM users) t WHERE DATEDIFF(register_date, prev_date) > 30 ORDER BY gap_days DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请返回所有用户中，注册日期为当月1号的用户数量，以及其中用户等级为gold或black的用户数量，仅返回这两项数值，不带列名。
intended_meaning: COUNT(*) 所有 register_date 是当月1号（即 DAY(register_date)=1）的用户；COUNT(*) 其中 user_level IN ('gold','black')；仅返回两个整数，无列别名，无排序。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(CASE WHEN user_level IN ('gold', 'black') THEN 1 END) FROM users WHERE DAY(register_date) = 1;

question: 请列出所有用户等级（user_level）中，注册于2026年8月的用户数量，以及这些用户中性别为'男'的比例（小数点后4位），按用户等级升序排列。
intended_meaning: 筛选 register_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' 的用户；按 user_level 分组；统计 COUNT(*) 和 ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gender='男' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4)；按 user_level 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT user_level, COUNT(*) AS aug2026_users, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN gender = '男' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS male_rate FROM users WHERE register_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY user_level ORDER BY user_level ASC;

question: 列出所有品牌为'云栖'且类别为'家用电器'的商品，返回商品名称、标价、成本价和是否在售状态，按标价从高到低排序，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 查询products表中brand='云栖'且category='家用电器'的所有记录，输出product_name、list_price、cost_price、is_active四列，ORDER BY list_price DESC LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT product_name, list_price, cost_price, is_active FROM products WHERE brand = '云栖' AND category = '家用电器' ORDER BY list_price DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个品牌下'手机数码'类商品的平均标价与平均成本价之差（保留2位小数），仅包含至少有5款在售商品的品牌，按差额从大到小排序，返回品牌、差额两列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand分组，筛选category='手机数码'且is_active=1的商品，计算AVG(list_price - cost_price)并四舍五入至2位小数；HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5；结果按该差额降序排列，输出brand和差额列。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, ROUND(AVG(list_price - cost_price), 2) AS price_cost_diff FROM products WHERE category = '手机数码' AND is_active = 1 GROUP BY brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY price_cost_diff DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有'食品生鲜'类且标价在30元至150元之间的在售商品，返回商品ID、商品名称、标价、成本价，按成本价升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 查询products表中category='食品生鲜'、list_price BETWEEN 30 AND 150、is_active=1的记录，输出product_id、product_name、list_price、cost_price四列，ORDER BY cost_price ASC LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, list_price, cost_price FROM products WHERE category = '食品生鲜' AND list_price BETWEEN 30 AND 150 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY cost_price ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计各品类下在售商品数量、平均标价（保留2位小数）、平均成本价（保留2位小数），仅展示商品数超过10个的品类，按商品数降序排列，返回品类、数量、平均标价、平均成本价四列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按category分组，筛选is_active=1的商品，COUNT(*) AS count，ROUND(AVG(list_price),2)，ROUND(AVG(cost_price),2)；HAVING count > 10；ORDER BY count DESC；输出category、count、avg_list_price、avg_cost_price四列。
reference_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_list_price, ROUND(AVG(cost_price), 2) AS avg_cost_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有品牌为'优选'或'北辰'的'美妆个护'类在售商品，返回商品名称、标价、成本价、标价与成本价之差（保留2位小数），按差额从高到低排序，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 查询products表中(brand='优选' OR brand='北辰') AND category='美妆个护' AND is_active=1的记录，输出product_name、list_price、cost_price、ROUND(list_price - cost_price, 2) AS price_cost_diff，ORDER BY price_cost_diff DESC LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT product_name, list_price, cost_price, ROUND(list_price - cost_price, 2) AS price_cost_diff FROM products WHERE (brand = '优选' OR brand = '北辰') AND category = '美妆个护' AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY price_cost_diff DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 找出所有标价高于成本价至少80元且属于'运动户外'类的在售商品，返回商品ID、商品名称、标价、成本价、价差，按价差降序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 查询products表中category='运动户外'、is_active=1、list_price - cost_price >= 80的记录，输出product_id、product_name、list_price、cost_price、(list_price - cost_price) AS price_diff，ORDER BY price_diff DESC LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, list_price, cost_price, (list_price - cost_price) AS price_diff FROM products WHERE category = '运动户外' AND is_active = 1 AND list_price - cost_price >= 80 ORDER BY price_diff DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个品牌在'服饰鞋包'类下的在售商品中，标价最高与最低之差（保留2位小数），仅包含差额大于200元的品牌，按差额降序排列，返回品牌、价差两列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand分组，筛选category='服饰鞋包'且is_active=1的商品，计算MAX(list_price) - MIN(list_price)并ROUND(,2)；HAVING该差额 > 200；ORDER BY差额DESC；输出brand和差额列。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, ROUND(MAX(list_price) - MIN(list_price), 2) AS price_range FROM products WHERE category = '服饰鞋包' AND is_active = 1 GROUP BY brand HAVING MAX(list_price) - MIN(list_price) > 200 ORDER BY price_range DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有'母婴用品'类中成本价低于50元且标价高于200元的在售商品，返回商品名称、标价、成本价、标价/成本价比值（保留4位小数），按比值从高到低排序，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 查询products表中category='母婴用品'、cost_price < 50、list_price > 200、is_active=1的记录，输出product_name、list_price、cost_price、ROUND(list_price / cost_price, 4) AS markup_ratio，ORDER BY markup_ratio DESC LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT product_name, list_price, cost_price, ROUND(list_price / cost_price, 4) AS markup_ratio FROM products WHERE category = '母婴用品' AND cost_price < 50 AND list_price > 200 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY markup_ratio DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计各品牌下'家用电器'类在售商品的标价中位数（保留2位小数）和成本价中位数（保留2位小数），仅展示商品数不少于3款的品牌，按标价中位数降序排列，返回品牌、标价中位数、成本价中位数三列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand分组，筛选category='家用电器'且is_active=1的商品；使用MySQL 8窗口函数计算中位数：对list_price和cost_price分别用ROW_NUMBER() + COUNT(*)求中位位置后取均值；HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3；ORDER BY标价中位数DESC；输出brand、median_list_price、median_cost_price三列。
reference_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT brand, list_price, cost_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY list_price) AS rn_p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY cost_price) AS rn_c, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY brand) AS cnt FROM products WHERE category = '家用电器' AND is_active = 1) SELECT brand, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rn_p IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2)) THEN list_price END), 2) AS median_list_price, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rn_c IN (FLOOR((cnt+1)/2), CEIL((cnt+1)/2)) THEN cost_price END), 2) AS median_cost_price FROM ranked GROUP BY brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY median_list_price DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有'手机数码'类中成本价在1000元至5000元之间、且标价是成本价1.3倍以上的在售商品，返回商品名称、成本价、标价、标价/成本价比值（保留4位小数），按比值升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 查询products表中category='手机数码'、cost_price BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000、list_price / cost_price > 1.3、is_active=1的记录，输出product_name、cost_price、list_price、ROUND(list_price / cost_price, 4) AS ratio，ORDER BY ratio ASC LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT product_name, cost_price, list_price, ROUND(list_price / cost_price, 4) AS ratio FROM products WHERE category = '手机数码' AND cost_price BETWEEN 1000 AND 5000 AND list_price / cost_price > 1.3 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY ratio ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）的品类、品牌、上市年份和上市月份，按上市年份升序、上市月份升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 查询products表中is_active=1的产品，提取category、brand、YEAR(launch_date)、MONTH(launch_date)，按年份和月份升序排序，限制100行。
reference_sql: SELECT category, brand, YEAR(launch_date) AS launch_year, MONTH(launch_date) AS launch_month FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY launch_year ASC, launch_month ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个品类下已上架产品（is_active=1）的数量、平均上市年份和平均上市季度，并按品类升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按category分组，对is_active=1的产品计算COUNT(*)、AVG(YEAR(launch_date))四舍五入到整数、AVG(QUARTER(launch_date))四舍五入到整数，结果按category升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(YEAR(launch_date)), 0) AS avg_launch_year, ROUND(AVG(QUARTER(launch_date)), 0) AS avg_launch_quarter FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC;

question: 列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）的品类、品牌、上市年份和上市季度，要求上市年份在2024年及以后，按上市年份降序、上市季度降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 查询is_active=1且launch_date >= '2024-01-01'的产品，返回category、brand、YEAR(launch_date)、QUARTER(launch_date)，按年份和季度降序排列，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT category, brand, YEAR(launch_date) AS launch_year, QUARTER(launch_date) AS launch_quarter FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND launch_date >= '2024-01-01' ORDER BY launch_year DESC, launch_quarter DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个品牌-品类组合下已上架产品（is_active=1）的上市年份分布：最小上市年份、最大上市年份、上市年份数量（去重），按品牌升序、品类升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按brand和category分组，对is_active=1的产品计算MIN(YEAR(launch_date))、MAX(YEAR(launch_date))、COUNT(DISTINCT YEAR(launch_date))，结果按brand和category升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, category, MIN(YEAR(launch_date)) AS min_launch_year, MAX(YEAR(launch_date)) AS max_launch_year, COUNT(DISTINCT YEAR(launch_date)) AS distinct_launch_years FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY brand, category ORDER BY brand ASC, category ASC;

question: 列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）中，上市年份为2025年的产品名称、品类、品牌、上市月份和销售单价（list_price），按上市月份升序、list_price降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 筛选is_active=1且YEAR(launch_date)=2025的产品，返回product_name、category、brand、MONTH(launch_date)、list_price，按上市月份升序、list_price降序排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT product_name, category, brand, MONTH(launch_date) AS launch_month, list_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(launch_date) = 2025 ORDER BY launch_month ASC, list_price DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个上市季度（按launch_date计算）中已上架产品（is_active=1）的平均售价（list_price）、平均成本价（cost_price）和毛利率（(list_price-cost_price)/list_price，保留四位小数），按上市季度升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按QUARTER(launch_date)分组，对is_active=1的产品计算AVG(list_price)保留2位小数、AVG(cost_price)保留2位小数、ROUND(AVG((list_price-cost_price)/NULLIF(list_price,0)),4)，结果按季度升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT QUARTER(launch_date) AS launch_quarter, ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_list_price, ROUND(AVG(cost_price), 2) AS avg_cost_price, ROUND(AVG((list_price - cost_price) / NULLIF(list_price, 0)), 4) AS markup_rate FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY launch_quarter ORDER BY launch_quarter ASC;

question: 列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）中，上市年份与上市月份构成的唯一组合（如2025年3月），以及该组合下的产品数量、平均售价（list_price）和平均成本价（cost_price），按上市年份升序、上市月份升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 按YEAR(launch_date)和MONTH(launch_date)分组，统计COUNT(*)、ROUND(AVG(list_price),2)、ROUND(AVG(cost_price),2)，结果按年份和月份升序排列，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT YEAR(launch_date) AS launch_year, MONTH(launch_date) AS launch_month, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_list_price, ROUND(AVG(cost_price), 2) AS avg_cost_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY launch_year, launch_month ORDER BY launch_year ASC, launch_month ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）中，上市年份为2024年或2025年的产品ID、品类、品牌、上市日期（launch_date）和售价（list_price），按上市日期升序、售价升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 筛选is_active=1且YEAR(launch_date) IN (2024,2025)的产品，返回product_id、category、brand、launch_date、list_price，按launch_date和list_price升序排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT product_id, category, brand, launch_date, list_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(launch_date) IN (2024, 2025) ORDER BY launch_date ASC, list_price ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个品类下已上架产品（is_active=1）的上市年份中位数（使用PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) OVER窗口函数模拟中位数逻辑，实际用子查询取中间值）、上市年份标准差（保留四位小数），按品类升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按category分组，对is_active=1的产品计算上市年份的中位数（通过排序取第N/2和(N+1)/2行平均）和STDDEV_POP(YEAR(launch_date))保留4位小数，结果按category升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(year_val), 0) AS median_launch_year, ROUND(STDDEV_POP(YEAR(launch_date)), 4) AS stddev_launch_year FROM (SELECT category, YEAR(launch_date) AS year_val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY YEAR(launch_date)) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS cnt FROM products WHERE is_active = 1) t WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt + 1) / 2), CEIL((cnt + 1) / 2)) GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC;

question: 列出所有已上架产品（is_active=1）中，上市年份为2026年的产品名称、品类、品牌、上市季度和成本价（cost_price），按上市季度升序、成本价降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 筛选is_active=1且YEAR(launch_date)=2026的产品，返回product_name、category、brand、QUARTER(launch_date)、cost_price，按上市季度升序、cost_price降序排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT product_name, category, brand, QUARTER(launch_date) AS launch_quarter, cost_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND YEAR(launch_date) = 2026 ORDER BY launch_quarter ASC, cost_price DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计所有订单状态（order_status）的分布次数，按次数降序排列，仅返回 order_status 和计数两列。
intended_meaning: 对 orders 表中所有 order_status 值进行频次统计，不加任何过滤，结果按计数从高到低排序，仅输出 order_status 和 COUNT(*)。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY count DESC;

question: 列出所有支付方式（payment_method）及其对应的有效订单数量（仅 order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')），按支付方式升序排列，仅返回 payment_method 和计数两列。
intended_meaning: 在 valid orders 约束下（order_status ∈ {'paid','completed','shipped'}），统计各 payment_method 出现次数，结果按 payment_method 字典序升序排列，仅输出 payment_method 和 COUNT(*)。
reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY payment_method ASC;

question: 统计2026年9月12日当天所有订单状态与支付方式的交叉组合次数，按订单状态升序、支付方式升序排列，仅返回 order_status、payment_method 和计数三列。
intended_meaning: 限定 order_date = '2026-09-12'，对 (order_status, payment_method) 二元组做频次聚合，结果先按 order_status 升序、再按 payment_method 升序排列，仅输出这两列及计数。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, payment_method, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE order_date = '2026-09-12' GROUP BY order_status, payment_method ORDER BY order_status ASC, payment_method ASC;

question: 统计每个订单日期（order_date）上出现的不同订单状态种类数（即该日 distinct order_status 的个数），仅返回 order_date 和状态种类数两列，并按 order_date 升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 order_date 分组，计算每日所含唯一 order_status 值的数量（COUNT(DISTINCT order_status)），结果按 order_date 升序排列，仅输出 order_date 和该计数。
reference_sql: SELECT order_date, COUNT(DISTINCT order_status) AS distinct_status_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date ASC;

question: 列出所有订单状态中，同时使用过至少3种不同支付方式（payment_method）的状态值，以及各自对应的支付方式种类数，按种类数降序、状态升序排列，仅返回 order_status 和支付方式种类数两列。
intended_meaning: 对 orders 按 order_status 分组，统计每组内 DISTINCT payment_method 数量；筛选出该数量 ≥ 3 的 order_status；结果按种类数降序、order_status 升序排列，仅输出 order_status 和 COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method)。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) >= 3 ORDER BY distinct_payment_count DESC, order_status ASC;

question: 统计每个支付方式下，各订单状态的出现次数，仅返回 payment_method、order_status 和计数三列，并按 payment_method 升序、计数降序排列。
intended_meaning: 对 orders 表按 (payment_method, order_status) 二元组分组计数，结果先按 payment_method 升序、再按计数降序排列，仅输出这三列。
reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, order_status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders GROUP BY payment_method, order_status ORDER BY payment_method ASC, count DESC;

question: 统计每个订单日期（order_date）上有效订单（order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')）的数量，以及该日全部订单总数，仅返回 order_date、有效订单数、总订单数三列，并按 order_date 升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 order_date 分组，分别计算：满足 valid orders 条件的行数，以及该日全部订单行数（无过滤），结果按 order_date 升序排列，仅输出 order_date、valid_count、total_count。
reference_sql: SELECT order_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') THEN 1 END) AS valid_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date ASC;

question: 列出所有在2026年9月12日前（不含）下单、且订单状态为 'cancelled' 或 'unpaid' 的订单中，出现过的全部支付方式，按支付方式升序排列，仅返回 payment_method 一列。
intended_meaning: 筛选 order_date < '2026-09-12' 且 order_status ∈ {'cancelled','unpaid'} 的记录，去重返回其 payment_method 列，按字典序升序排列，仅输出该列。
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT payment_method FROM orders WHERE order_date < '2026-09-12' AND order_status IN ('cancelled', 'unpaid') ORDER BY payment_method ASC;

question: 统计每个订单状态中，订单日期在2026年9月12日当月（2026-09-01 至 2026-09-30）的订单占比（小数点后4位），仅返回 order_status 和占比两列，并按占比降序排列。
intended_meaning: 计算每个 order_status 下，order_date 属于 2026年9月（含首尾）的订单数占该状态总订单数的比例，四舍五入保留4位小数；结果按该比例降序排列，仅输出 order_status 和该比率。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY rate DESC;

question: 统计每个支付方式下，订单状态为 'paid' 的订单平均下单日期（取 order_date 的 AVG，按天计算），仅返回 payment_method 和平均日期两列，并按支付方式升序排列。
intended_meaning: 对 payment_method 分组，在 order_status = 'paid' 的子集中，计算 order_date 的平均值（MySQL DATE 类型 AVG 返回合法日期），结果按 payment_method 升序排列，仅输出 payment_method 和 AVG(order_date)。
reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, AVG(order_date) AS avg_order_date FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'paid' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY payment_method ASC;

question: 请列出所有订单状态对应的总订单数、总毛额（gross_amount）、总折扣额（discount_amount）和实收金额（paid_amount），按订单状态升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 orders.order_status 分组，统计 COUNT(*)、SUM(gross_amount)、SUM(discount_amount)、SUM(paid_amount)，结果按 order_status 字典序升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(gross_amount) AS gross_amount, SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_amount, SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status ASC;

question: 请计算每个支付方式在全部历史订单中的总毛额、总折扣额和总实收金额，并按支付方式升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 orders.payment_method 分组，统计 SUM(gross_amount)、SUM(discount_amount)、SUM(paid_amount)，结果按 payment_method 字典序升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(gross_amount) AS gross_amount, SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_amount, SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY payment_method ASC;

question: 请返回全部历史订单中，各订单状态的实收金额总和与毛额总和的比值（即平均实收率，保留4位小数），并按订单状态升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 order_status 分组，计算 SUM(paid_amount)/SUM(gross_amount) 作为实收率（注意处理分母为0），四舍五入保留4位小数，结果按 order_status 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, ROUND(SUM(paid_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_amount), 0), 4) AS paid_to_gross_rate FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status ASC;

question: 请列出所有订单状态中，总折扣额占总毛额比例超过15%的那些状态，及其对应的总毛额、总折扣额、总实收金额，按折扣占比降序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 order_status 分组，计算 SUM(discount_amount)/SUM(gross_amount) > 0.15 的状态，返回 order_status、SUM(gross_amount)、SUM(discount_amount)、SUM(paid_amount)，结果按折扣占比（降序）排列。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, SUM(gross_amount) AS gross_amount, SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_amount, SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders GROUP BY order_status HAVING SUM(discount_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_amount), 0) > 0.15 ORDER BY SUM(discount_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_amount), 0) DESC;

question: 请统计全部历史订单中，不同订单状态下的平均单笔订单毛额、平均单笔订单折扣额和平均单笔订单实收金额（均保留2位小数），按订单状态升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 order_status 分组，计算 AVG(gross_amount)、AVG(discount_amount)、AVG(paid_amount)，四舍五入保留2位小数，结果按 order_status 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, ROUND(AVG(gross_amount), 2) AS avg_gross_amount, ROUND(AVG(discount_amount), 2) AS avg_discount_amount, ROUND(AVG(paid_amount), 2) AS avg_paid_amount FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status ASC;

question: 请返回全部历史订单中，各订单状态的总实收金额占全部历史订单总实收金额的比例（即状态贡献率，保留4位小数），并按该比例降序排列。
intended_meaning: 先计算全部历史订单 SUM(paid_amount) 总量，再按 order_status 分组求 SUM(paid_amount)，计算各状态占比（ROUND(..., 4)），结果按占比降序排列。
reference_sql: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(paid_amount) AS total_paid FROM orders) SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount) / NULLIF(t.total_paid, 0), 4) AS paid_contribution_rate FROM orders o CROSS JOIN total t GROUP BY o.order_status, t.total_paid ORDER BY paid_contribution_rate DESC;

question: 请列出全部历史订单中，订单状态为'paid'、'completed'或'shipped'的三类有效订单各自的总毛额、总折扣额和总实收金额，按订单状态升序排列。
intended_meaning: WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')，按 order_status 分组，统计 SUM(gross_amount)、SUM(discount_amount)、SUM(paid_amount)，结果按 order_status 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, SUM(gross_amount) AS gross_amount, SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_amount, SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status ASC;

question: 请计算全部历史订单中，每种订单状态的总折扣额占其对应总毛额的比例（即该状态下的平均折扣率，保留4位小数），并按订单状态升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 order_status 分组，计算 SUM(discount_amount)/SUM(gross_amount) 作为折扣率（处理除零），四舍五入保留4位小数，结果按 order_status 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, ROUND(SUM(discount_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_amount), 0), 4) AS discount_rate FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status ASC;

question: 请返回全部历史订单中，订单状态为'cancelled'或'unpaid'的两类无效订单各自的总毛额、总折扣额和总实收金额，按订单状态升序排列。
intended_meaning: WHERE order_status IN ('cancelled','unpaid')，按 order_status 分组，统计 SUM(gross_amount)、SUM(discount_amount)、SUM(paid_amount)，结果按 order_status 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, SUM(gross_amount) AS gross_amount, SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_amount, SUM(paid_amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('cancelled', 'unpaid') GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status ASC;

question: 请列出全部历史订单中，各订单状态的总实收金额与总毛额之差（即总未收金额，等于总折扣额+其他应收差额，此处直接用 gross_amount - paid_amount 求和），并按订单状态升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按 order_status 分组，计算 SUM(gross_amount - paid_amount) 作为未收金额，结果按 order_status 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT order_status, SUM(gross_amount - paid_amount) AS uncollected_amount FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status ASC;

question: 请列出所有客户的首次下单日期、最近一次下单日期、有效订单总次数以及使用的不同支付方式数量，按客户ID升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对每个用户（users.user_id）计算：最早order_date（MIN(orders.order_date)）、最晚order_date（MAX(orders.order_date)）、在valid orders（order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')）中的订单数（COUNT）、所用不同payment_method种类数（COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method)），结果按user_id ASC排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.payment_method) AS distinct_payment_method_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.user_id ORDER BY u.user_id ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计每个客户等级（user_level）下，客户平均有效订单次数、平均使用支付方式数，以及该等级内至少下过3次有效订单的客户占比，按客户等级升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按users.user_level分组，计算：该等级下所有客户的平均有效订单数（AVG(valid_order_count)）、平均不同支付方式数（AVG(distinct_payment_count)）、该等级中valid_order_count >= 3 的客户占该等级总客户数的比例（ROUND(COUNT_IF(valid_order_count>=3)/COUNT(*),4)），结果按user_level ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_level, AVG(t.valid_order_count) AS avg_valid_order_count, AVG(t.distinct_payment_count) AS avg_distinct_payment_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.valid_order_count >= 3 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate_customers_with_at_least_3_orders FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY user_id) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.user_level ORDER BY u.user_level ASC;

question: 请列出所有在2026年9月12日之前注册、且至少完成过1次有效订单的客户，返回其用户ID、注册日期、首次下单日期、有效订单总次数及是否为VIP（is_vip），按注册日期升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: JOIN users与orders（on user_id），筛选users.register_date < '2026-09-12' 且 orders.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')，对每个用户取MIN(order_date)为首次下单日、COUNT(*)为有效订单次数，返回user_id, register_date, first_order_date, valid_order_count, is_vip，按register_date ASC排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.register_date, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, u.is_vip FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') WHERE u.register_date < '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.register_date, u.is_vip ORDER BY u.register_date ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计各城市中，客户平均有效订单次数、平均不同支付方式数、以及该城市客户中使用超过2种支付方式的比例，按城市名称升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按users.city分组，计算：该城市所有客户的平均有效订单数（AVG(valid_order_count)）、平均不同支付方式数（AVG(distinct_payment_count)）、该城市中distinct_payment_count > 2 的客户数占该城市总客户数的比例（ROUND(COUNT_IF(distinct_payment_count>2)/COUNT(*),4)），结果按city ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.city, AVG(t.valid_order_count) AS avg_valid_order_count, AVG(t.distinct_payment_count) AS avg_distinct_payment_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.distinct_payment_count > 2 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate_customers_using_more_than_2_payment_methods FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY user_id) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY u.city ASC;

question: 请列出所有在2026年9月12日前完成过至少2次有效订单、且使用过微信和支付宝两种支付方式的客户，返回其用户ID、用户姓名、注册日期、有效订单次数及使用的支付方式列表（逗号分隔），按注册日期降序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: JOIN users与orders（valid orders），GROUP BY user_id，HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN payment_method IN ('wechat','alipay') THEN payment_method END)=2；用GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT payment_method ORDER BY payment_method)生成支付方式列表；返回user_id, user_name, register_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, payment_list；按register_date DESC排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.register_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.payment_method ORDER BY o.payment_method SEPARATOR ',') AS payment_list FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.register_date HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.payment_method IN ('wechat','alipay') THEN o.payment_method END) = 2 ORDER BY u.register_date DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计各客户等级（user_level）中，首末订单时间跨度（天数）大于30天的客户占比、平均订单频次（有效订单数/注册天数）、以及该等级客户平均使用支付方式数，按客户等级升序排列。
intended_meaning: 对每个用户，计算：first_order_date、last_order_date、注册天数（DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', register_date)+1）、订单跨度（DATEDIFF(last_order_date, first_order_date)）；按user_level分组，计算：该等级中订单跨度>30天的客户占比（ROUND(COUNT_IF(span>30)/COUNT(*),4)）、平均订单频次（SUM(valid_order_count)*1.0/SUM(reg_days)）、平均支付方式数（AVG(distinct_payment_count)）；结果按user_level ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_level, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.span > 30 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate_span_gt30_days, ROUND(SUM(t.valid_order_count) * 1.0 / SUM(t.reg_days), 4) AS avg_order_frequency_per_reg_day, AVG(t.distinct_payment_count) AS avg_distinct_payment_method FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date, MAX(order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count, DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', MIN(order_date)) AS span, DATEDIFF('2026-09-12', u2.register_date) + 1 AS reg_days FROM orders o INNER JOIN users u2 ON o.user_id = u2.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY user_id) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.user_level ORDER BY u.user_level ASC;

question: 请列出所有在2026年9月12日当天或之前有下单记录、且有效订单次数不少于5次的客户，返回其用户ID、城市、客户等级、首次下单日期、最近一次下单日期及有效订单总次数，按有效订单次数降序、用户ID升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: JOIN users与orders（order_date <= '2026-09-12' 且 order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')），GROUP BY user_id, city, user_level，HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5；返回user_id, city, user_level, MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date), COUNT(*)；ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, user_id ASC；LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.city, u.user_level, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_date <= '2026-09-12' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.user_id, u.city, u.user_level HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, u.user_id ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计各性别客户中，平均有效订单次数、平均不同支付方式数、以及该性别中使用过全部三种主流支付方式（alipay/wechat/card）的客户占比，按性别升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按users.gender分组，计算：平均有效订单数（AVG(valid_order_count)）、平均不同支付方式数（AVG(distinct_payment_count)）、该性别中payment_method集合包含'alipay','wechat','card'三者的客户数占比（ROUND(COUNT_IF(has_all_three)/COUNT(*),4)），其中has_all_three通过检查GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT payment_method)是否含全部三个值判断；结果按gender ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.gender, AVG(t.valid_order_count) AS avg_valid_order_count, AVG(t.distinct_payment_count) AS avg_distinct_payment_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.has_all_three THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate_has_alipay_wechat_card FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN payment_method IN ('alipay','wechat','card') THEN payment_method END) = 3 AS has_all_three FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY user_id) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.gender ORDER BY u.gender ASC;

question: 请列出所有在2025年1月1日后注册、且首末订单时间跨度超过180天的客户，返回其用户ID、注册日期、首次下单日期、最近一次下单日期、有效订单次数及是否为VIP，按首末订单跨度降序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: JOIN users与orders（valid orders），筛选register_date > '2025-01-01'，GROUP BY user_id等关键字段，计算span = DATEDIFF(MAX(order_date), MIN(order_date))，HAVING span > 180；返回user_id, register_date, MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date), COUNT(*), is_vip；ORDER BY span DESC, user_id ASC；LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.register_date, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, u.is_vip FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') WHERE u.register_date > '2025-01-01' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.register_date, u.is_vip HAVING DATEDIFF(MAX(o.order_date), MIN(o.order_date)) > 180 ORDER BY DATEDIFF(MAX(o.order_date), MIN(o.order_date)) DESC, u.user_id ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计各省份中，客户平均有效订单次数、平均不同支付方式数、以及该省份中同时使用过线上（alipay/wechat）和线下（card/cash）支付方式的客户占比，按省份升序排列。
intended_meaning: 按users.province分组，计算：平均有效订单数（AVG(valid_order_count)）、平均不同支付方式数（AVG(distinct_payment_count)）、该省份中既使用过线上支付（alipay或wechat）又使用过线下支付（card或cash）的客户占比（ROUND(COUNT_IF(has_online AND has_offline)/COUNT(*),4)），其中has_online和has_offline分别通过CASE聚合判断；结果按province ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT u.province, AVG(t.valid_order_count) AS avg_valid_order_count, AVG(t.distinct_payment_count) AS avg_distinct_payment_count, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.has_online AND t.has_offline THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS rate_has_online_and_offline FROM users u LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_method) AS distinct_payment_count, MAX(CASE WHEN payment_method IN ('alipay','wechat') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_online, MAX(CASE WHEN payment_method IN ('card','cash') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS has_offline FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY user_id) t ON u.user_id = t.user_id GROUP BY u.province ORDER BY u.province ASC;

question: 列出所有商品行中 quantity 大于 10 的订单项，返回 order_item_id、product_id、quantity、unit_price 和 item_amount，按 quantity 降序排列，最多返回 100 行。
intended_meaning: 从 order_items 表筛选 quantity > 10 的记录，输出指定五列，按 quantity DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT order_item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, item_amount FROM order_items WHERE quantity > 10 ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个订单内商品行的平均 quantity、平均 unit_price 和总 item_amount，并仅返回 order_id、avg_quantity、avg_unit_price、sum_item_amount 四列，按 sum_item_amount 降序排列，最多 100 行。
intended_meaning: 按 order_id 分组，计算每组 quantity 和 unit_price 的平均值、item_amount 的总和，输出四列并按 sum_item_amount DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT order_id, AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(item_amount) AS sum_item_amount FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY sum_item_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 找出 discount_amount 占 item_amount 比例最高的前 100 个商品行，返回 order_item_id、product_id、discount_amount、item_amount 和 discount_rate（保留4位小数），按 discount_rate 降序排列。
intended_meaning: 计算每行 discount_amount / item_amount 为 discount_rate（非空且 item_amount > 0），取前100高值，输出指定五列，按 discount_rate DESC 排序。
reference_sql: SELECT order_item_id, product_id, discount_amount, item_amount, ROUND(discount_amount / item_amount, 4) AS discount_rate FROM order_items WHERE item_amount > 0 ORDER BY discount_rate DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有 unit_price 小于 50 且 item_amount 大于 100 的商品行，返回 order_item_id、order_id、product_id、unit_price、item_amount，按 unit_price 升序、item_amount 降序排列，最多 100 行。
intended_meaning: 从 order_items 表筛选 unit_price < 50 且 item_amount > 100 的记录，输出五列，先按 unit_price ASC、再按 item_amount DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT order_item_id, order_id, product_id, unit_price, item_amount FROM order_items WHERE unit_price < 50 AND item_amount > 100 ORDER BY unit_price ASC, item_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个 product_id 对应的商品行中 quantity 的最小值、最大值、平均值和标准差（保留2位小数），返回 product_id、min_quantity、max_quantity、avg_quantity、stddev_quantity，按 avg_quantity 降序排列，最多 100 行。
intended_meaning: 按 product_id 分组，计算 quantity 的 MIN/MAX/AVG/STDDEV，输出五列，avg_quantity DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT product_id, MIN(quantity) AS min_quantity, MAX(quantity) AS max_quantity, ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity, ROUND(STDDEV(quantity), 2) AS stddev_quantity FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有 item_amount 为 0 的商品行，返回 order_item_id、order_id、product_id、quantity、unit_price，按 order_id 升序、order_item_id 升序排列，最多 100 行。
intended_meaning: 筛选 order_items 中 item_amount = 0 的记录，输出五列，按 order_id ASC、order_item_id ASC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT order_item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price FROM order_items WHERE item_amount = 0 ORDER BY order_id ASC, order_item_id ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 计算每个 order_id 内所有商品行的 discount_amount 总和与 item_amount 总和，并返回 order_id、sum_discount_amount、sum_item_amount、discount_ratio（= sum_discount_amount / sum_item_amount，保留4位小数），仅包含 sum_item_amount > 0 的订单，按 discount_ratio 降序排列，最多 100 行。
intended_meaning: 按 order_id 分组，SUM discount_amount 和 item_amount，计算折扣率（分母非零），输出四列，discount_ratio DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(discount_amount) AS sum_discount_amount, SUM(item_amount) AS sum_item_amount, ROUND(SUM(discount_amount) / SUM(item_amount), 4) AS discount_ratio FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(item_amount) > 0 ORDER BY discount_ratio DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有 quantity 为 1 且 unit_price 在 100 到 500 之间的商品行，返回 order_item_id、product_id、quantity、unit_price、item_amount，按 unit_price 降序排列，最多 100 行。
intended_meaning: 筛选 quantity = 1 且 unit_price BETWEEN 100 AND 500 的 order_items 记录，输出五列，按 unit_price DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT order_item_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, item_amount FROM order_items WHERE quantity = 1 AND unit_price BETWEEN 100 AND 500 ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个 product_id 对应商品行中 item_amount 的中位数（使用 MySQL 8 窗口函数近似：第50百分位）、最小值、最大值，返回 product_id、median_item_amount、min_item_amount、max_item_amount，按 median_item_amount 降序排列，最多 100 行。
intended_meaning: 按 product_id 分组，用 PERCENT_RANK() 或窗口函数近似中位数（取最接近 0.5 的 item_amount），同时计算 MIN/MAX item_amount，输出四列，median_item_amount DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT product_id, item_amount, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY item_amount) AS pr FROM order_items) SELECT product_id, MIN(CASE WHEN pr >= 0.5 THEN item_amount END) AS median_item_amount, MIN(item_amount) AS min_item_amount, MAX(item_amount) AS max_item_amount FROM ranked GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY median_item_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有 discount_amount 不为 NULL 且大于 0 的商品行，返回 order_item_id、order_id、product_id、discount_amount、unit_price，按 discount_amount 降序、unit_price 升序排列，最多 100 行。
intended_meaning: 筛选 discount_amount IS NOT NULL 且 > 0 的 order_items 记录，输出五列，先按 discount_amount DESC、再按 unit_price ASC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT order_item_id, order_id, product_id, discount_amount, unit_price FROM order_items WHERE discount_amount IS NOT NULL AND discount_amount > 0 ORDER BY discount_amount DESC, unit_price ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有品牌与品类组合中，2026年9月12日前上架且当前在售的商品数量、平均售价（保留2位小数）、平均成本价（保留2位小数）及价格加成率（= (平均售价 - 平均成本价) / 平均成本价，保留4位小数），按商品数量降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand和category分组，筛选is_active=1且launch_date <= '2026-09-12'的商品，统计每组product_id数量、AVG(list_price)、AVG(cost_price)及对应加成率，结果按count desc排序，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, category, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_price, ROUND(AVG(cost_price), 2) AS avg_cost, ROUND((AVG(list_price) - AVG(cost_price)) / NULLIF(AVG(cost_price), 0), 4) AS markup_rate FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND launch_date <= '2026-09-12' GROUP BY brand, category ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计每个品牌下各品类中，近30天（以2026-09-12为基准）产生过销售的有效订单所覆盖的商品SKU数（即order_items.product_id去重计数），要求仅包含至少被5个不同用户购买过的品牌-品类组合，结果按覆盖SKU数降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 联结orders、order_items、products，限定orders.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 30 DAY)且order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')，按brand+category分组，COUNT(DISTINCT order_items.product_id)，同时HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT orders.user_id) >= 5，结果按SKU数降序排列，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS sku_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) >= 5 ORDER BY sku_count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有在售（is_active=1）商品中，所属品牌与品类组合的订单覆盖率（定义为：该品牌-品类组合下有销售记录的订单数 / 全部有效订单总数，保留4位小数），仅展示覆盖率大于0.5%的品牌与品类，按覆盖率降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 联结orders、order_items、products，限定orders.order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')且products.is_active=1，按brand+category分组计算COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)，除以全部有效订单总数，过滤结果>0.005，保留4位小数，按该比率降序排列，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, p.category, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')), 4) AS coverage_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING coverage_rate > 0.005 ORDER BY coverage_rate DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请输出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的最低售价、最高售价、价格带宽度（= 最高-最低），以及该组合内商品均价（保留2位小数），仅包含价格带宽度超过200元且商品数不少于8个的组合，按价格带宽度降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand+category分组，筛选is_active=1，计算MIN(list_price)、MAX(list_price)、MAX-MIN、ROUND(AVG(list_price),2)，HAVING (MAX-MIN) > 200 AND COUNT(*) >= 8，按价格带宽度降序排列，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, category, MIN(list_price) AS min_price, MAX(list_price) AS max_price, MAX(list_price) - MIN(list_price) AS price_range_width, ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY brand, category HAVING price_range_width > 200 AND COUNT(*) >= 8 ORDER BY price_range_width DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，在2026年9月12日前已上架且当前在售的商品里，单价（list_price）处于[100, 500]区间的商品数量、该区间内商品的平均成本价（保留2位小数）及平均毛利率（= (平均售价 - 平均成本价) / 平均售价，保留4位小数），按商品数量降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand+category分组，筛选is_active=1且launch_date <= '2026-09-12'且list_price BETWEEN 100 AND 500，统计COUNT(*)、ROUND(AVG(cost_price),2)、ROUND((AVG(list_price)-AVG(cost_price))/NULLIF(AVG(list_price),0),4)，按数量降序排列，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, category, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(cost_price), 2) AS avg_cost, ROUND((AVG(list_price) - AVG(cost_price)) / NULLIF(AVG(list_price), 0), 4) AS gross_margin FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND launch_date <= '2026-09-12' AND list_price BETWEEN 100 AND 500 GROUP BY brand, category ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的销量集中度（定义为：销量TOP3商品的销量之和 / 该组合全部商品销量总和，保留4位小数），仅展示销量总和不低于1000件的组合，按集中度升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 联结products、order_items，按brand+category分组，先计算每组合总销量SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty，再用窗口函数对每个组合内product_id按SUM(oi.quantity) DESC排序取前3，求和后除以total_qty；HAVING total_qty >= 1000；结果按集中度ASC排序，限100行。
reference_sql: WITH brand_cat_totals AS (SELECT p.brand, p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) >= 1000), ranked_skus AS (SELECT p.brand, p.category, oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sku_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.brand, p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY p.brand, p.category, oi.product_id) SELECT bct.brand, bct.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rs.rn <= 3 THEN rs.sku_qty ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / bct.total_qty, 4) AS concentration FROM brand_cat_totals bct JOIN ranked_skus rs ON bct.brand = rs.brand AND bct.category = rs.category GROUP BY bct.brand, bct.category, bct.total_qty ORDER BY concentration ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的平均售价（保留2位小数）与平均销量（按order_items.quantity计算，保留2位小数）的乘积（即预估销售额权重），仅包含平均售价高于300元且平均销量大于5的组合，按该乘积降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 联结products、order_items，按brand+category分组，计算ROUND(AVG(p.list_price),2)、ROUND(AVG(oi.quantity),2)，相乘得权重；HAVING AVG(p.list_price) > 300 AND AVG(oi.quantity) > 5；按乘积降序排列，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, p.category, ROUND(AVG(p.list_price) * AVG(oi.quantity), 2) AS price_quantity_weight FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING AVG(p.list_price) > 300 AND AVG(oi.quantity) > 5 ORDER BY price_quantity_weight DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的平均单位利润（= 平均售价 - 平均成本价，保留2位小数）及对应商品数量，仅包含平均单位利润在50至200元之间且商品数不少于15个的组合，按平均单位利润降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand+category分组，筛选is_active=1，计算ROUND(AVG(list_price) - AVG(cost_price), 2) AS unit_profit，COUNT(*)，HAVING unit_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 200 AND COUNT(*) >= 15，按unit_profit DESC排序，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT brand, category, ROUND(AVG(list_price) - AVG(cost_price), 2) AS unit_profit, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 GROUP BY brand, category HAVING unit_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 200 AND COUNT(*) >= 15 ORDER BY unit_profit DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品在近7天（以2026-09-12为基准）产生的销售数量、销售金额（保留2位小数）及平均客单价（= 销售金额 / 有效订单数，保留2位小数），仅展示销售金额超过5000元的组合，按销售金额降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 联结orders、order_items、products，限定order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 7 DAY)且order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')，按brand+category分组，SUM(oi.quantity)、ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount),2)、ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2)，HAVING SUM(oi.item_amount) > 5000，按销售金额DESC排序，限100行。
reference_sql: SELECT p.brand, p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount), 2) AS amount, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.brand, p.category HAVING SUM(oi.item_amount) > 5000 ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的销售价格分布偏态（Skewness）估算值（使用三阶中心矩公式：N·Σ(x_i−x̄)³/((N−1)(N−2)·s³)，保留4位小数），仅包含商品数不少于20个的组合，按偏态绝对值升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对products表按brand+category分组，筛选is_active=1且COUNT(*)>=20，使用MySQL窗口函数近似计算偏态（需先算均值、标准差，再聚合三阶中心矩），结果按ABS(skewness) ASC排序，限100行。
reference_sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT brand, category, list_price, AVG(list_price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, category) AS mean_price, STDDEV_SAMP(list_price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, category) AS std_price, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, category) AS n FROM products WHERE is_active = 1), moments AS (SELECT brand, category, n, SUM(POW(list_price - mean_price, 3)) AS m3, std_price FROM stats WHERE std_price > 0 GROUP BY brand, category, n, std_price HAVING n >= 20) SELECT brand, category, ROUND((n * m3) / ((n - 1) * (n - 2) * POW(std_price, 3)), 4) AS skewness FROM moments ORDER BY ABS(skewness) ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 列出所有退款原因及其对应的已批准退款金额总和，按金额从高到低排序，仅返回退款原因和金额两列。
intended_meaning: 对refunds表按refund_reason分组，SUM(refund_amount)仅限refund_status='approved'的记录，结果按该和降序排列，输出refund_reason和SUM(refund_amount)两列。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_reason, SUM(refund_amount) AS sum_refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_reason ORDER BY sum_refund_amount DESC;

question: 统计2026年9月12日前30天内（含当日）每天的已批准退款笔数和总金额，按日期升序排列，仅返回日期、笔数、金额三列。
intended_meaning: 筛选refund_date在[DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 29 DAY), '2026-09-12']范围内且refund_status='approved'的退款记录，按refund_date分组，COUNT(*)和SUM(refund_amount)，结果按refund_date ASC排序，输出refund_date、COUNT(*)、SUM(refund_amount)。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_date, COUNT(*) AS count_refunds, SUM(refund_amount) AS sum_refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' AND refund_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY refund_date ORDER BY refund_date ASC;

question: 查询退款状态为‘已批准’的退款中，各退款原因的退款金额占比（占全部已批准退款总额的比例），保留四位小数，按占比从高到低排序，仅返回退款原因和占比两列。
intended_meaning: 先计算全部已批准退款总金额，再对每个refund_reason计算其SUM(refund_amount)/总金额，结果四舍五入至4位小数，按该比率降序排列，输出refund_reason和占比。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_reason, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount) / (SELECT SUM(refund_amount) FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved'), 4) AS rate FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_reason ORDER BY rate DESC;

question: 列出退款状态为‘已批准’且退款原因为‘七天无理由’的退款记录中，退款金额最高的前5条，仅返回退款单号、退款金额、退款日期三列，并按金额降序排列。
intended_meaning: 筛选refund_status='approved'且refund_reason='七天无理由'的记录，取refund_amount DESC LIMIT 5，输出refund_no、refund_amount、refund_date。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_no, refund_amount, refund_date FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' AND refund_reason = '七天无理由' ORDER BY refund_amount DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 统计各退款状态（refund_status）对应的退款笔数、已批准退款金额总和、以及平均单笔退款金额（仅对已批准退款计算），按退款状态升序排列，仅返回退款状态、笔数、已批准金额总和、平均金额四列。
intended_meaning: 按refund_status分组；COUNT(*)为总笔数；SUM(CASE WHEN refund_status='approved' THEN refund_amount ELSE 0 END)为已批准金额总和；AVG(CASE WHEN refund_status='approved' THEN refund_amount END)为已批准退款的平均单笔金额（NULL值自动忽略），结果按refund_status ASC排序。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_status, COUNT(*) AS count_refunds, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_status = 'approved' THEN refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sum_approved_amount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN refund_status = 'approved' THEN refund_amount END), 2) AS avg_approved_amount FROM refunds GROUP BY refund_status ORDER BY refund_status ASC;

question: 查询退款日期在2026年9月1日至2026年9月12日之间（含首尾）的所有已批准退款，按退款日期分组统计每日退款金额总和，仅返回日期和金额两列，并按日期升序排列。
intended_meaning: 筛选refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12' 且 refund_status='approved' 的记录，按refund_date分组求SUM(refund_amount)，结果按refund_date ASC排序，输出refund_date和SUM(refund_amount)。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_date, SUM(refund_amount) AS sum_refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' AND refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY refund_date ORDER BY refund_date ASC;

question: 列出退款状态为‘已批准’的退款中，退款金额大于500元的退款记录，按退款金额从高到低排序，仅返回退款单号、退款原因、退款金额三列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 筛选refund_status='approved'且refund_amount > 500的记录，按refund_amount DESC排序，输出refund_no、refund_reason、refund_amount，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_no, refund_reason, refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' AND refund_amount > 500 ORDER BY refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计退款原因中出现次数最多的前3个原因及其对应退款笔数，仅返回退款原因和笔数两列，按笔数降序排列。
intended_meaning: 对refunds表按refund_reason分组计数，取COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3，输出refund_reason和COUNT(*)。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS count_refunds FROM refunds GROUP BY refund_reason ORDER BY count_refunds DESC LIMIT 3;

question: 查询退款状态为‘已批准’的退款中，退款原因不为‘七天无理由’的所有记录，按退款日期升序、退款金额降序排列，仅返回退款单号、退款原因、退款日期、退款金额四列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 筛选refund_status='approved'且refund_reason != '七天无理由'的记录，ORDER BY refund_date ASC, refund_amount DESC，输出refund_no、refund_reason、refund_date、refund_amount，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_no, refund_reason, refund_date, refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' AND refund_reason != '七天无理由' ORDER BY refund_date ASC, refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计2026年9月12日当天所有退款记录中，各退款状态的分布数量（含‘已批准’‘已拒绝’‘待处理’），按退款状态升序排列，仅返回退款状态和数量两列。
intended_meaning: 筛选refund_date = '2026-09-12'的所有退款记录，按refund_status分组COUNT(*)，结果按refund_status ASC排序，输出refund_status和COUNT(*)。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_status, COUNT(*) AS count_refunds FROM refunds WHERE refund_date = '2026-09-12' GROUP BY refund_status ORDER BY refund_status ASC;

question: 请列出所有退款订单对应的支付方式，以及每种支付方式下批准的退款总金额和退款订单数，按退款订单数降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对 refunds 表中 refund_status='approved' 的记录，通过 orders 表关联 payment_method，按 payment_method 分组，统计 COUNT(*) 和 SUM(refund_amount)，结果按 COUNT(*) DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT o.payment_method, COUNT(*) AS refund_order_count, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_approved_refund_amount FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY o.payment_method ORDER BY refund_order_count DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计每个订单状态（order_status）下，对应已批准退款的订单数量、平均退款金额（保留2位小数）及该状态订单的总支付金额（仅含 valid orders），按订单状态升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对 refunds 中 refund_status='approved' 的记录，关联 orders 获取 order_status；按 order_status 分组，统计 COUNT(*)、AVG(refund_amount) 四舍五入至2位小数、SUM(o.paid_amount)（仅限 valid orders：order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')）；结果按 order_status ASC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(*) AS approved_refund_order_count, ROUND(AVG(r.refund_amount), 2) AS avg_approved_refund_amount, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS total_paid_amount_of_valid_orders FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY o.order_status ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出近30天（以2026-09-12为基准）内发生退款的订单号、订单状态、支付方式、退款原因和批准的退款金额，按退款金额降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 筛选 refunds 表中 refund_status='approved' 且 refund_date 在 [2026-08-14, 2026-09-12] 区间内的记录；关联 orders 获取 order_no、order_status、payment_method、refund_reason、refund_amount；结果按 refund_amount DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_no, o.order_status, o.payment_method, r.refund_reason, r.refund_amount FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-08-14' AND '2026-09-12' ORDER BY r.refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计每个退款原因下，对应的有效订单（paid/completed/shipped）数量、批准退款总金额（保留2位小数）及该原因退款占全部批准退款金额的比例（保留4位小数），按比例降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 对 refunds 中 refund_status='approved' 的记录，关联 orders 筛选 valid orders；按 refund_reason 分组，统计 COUNT(*)、SUM(refund_amount)、SUM(refund_amount)/SUM(SUM(refund_amount)) OVER()；所有数值按要求四舍五入；结果按比例 DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT r.refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS valid_order_count_with_refund, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS total_approved_refund_amount, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount) / SUM(SUM(r.refund_amount)) OVER(), 4) AS rate_of_total_approved_refund FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY r.refund_reason ORDER BY rate_of_total_approved_refund DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有存在已批准退款的订单ID、订单状态、支付方式、订单日期、退款日期和退款金额，要求退款日期不晚于订单日期，按订单日期升序、退款金额降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 关联 refunds 与 orders，筛选 refund_status='approved' 且 refund_date <= order_date 的记录；返回 order_id、order_status、payment_method、order_date、refund_date、refund_amount；按 order_date ASC、refund_amount DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, o.payment_method, o.order_date, r.refund_date, r.refund_amount FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_date <= o.order_date ORDER BY o.order_date ASC, r.refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计每个支付方式下，对应已批准退款的订单中，不同订单状态（paid/completed/shipped/cancelled/unpaid）的分布数量，按支付方式升序、订单状态升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 关联 refunds（refund_status='approved'）与 orders；按 payment_method 和 order_status 分组；统计 COUNT(*)；结果按 payment_method ASC、order_status ASC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT o.payment_method, o.order_status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY o.payment_method, o.order_status ORDER BY o.payment_method ASC, o.order_status ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有退款订单的订单号、客户所在城市、订单状态、支付方式、退款原因和批准的退款金额，要求客户城市来自【上海市、北京市、广州市、成都市】，按退款金额降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 三表关联：refunds → orders → users；筛选 refunds.refund_status='approved' 且 users.city ∈ ('上海市','北京市','广州市','成都市')；返回 order_no、city、order_status、payment_method、refund_reason、refund_amount；按 refund_amount DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_no, u.city, o.order_status, o.payment_method, r.refund_reason, r.refund_amount FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id INNER JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND u.city IN ('上海市', '北京市', '广州市', '成都市') ORDER BY r.refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计每个订单状态（order_status）下，对应已批准退款的订单中，使用微信支付（wechat）和支付宝（alipay）的退款订单数及总退款金额（保留2位小数），按订单状态升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 关联 refunds（refund_status='approved'）与 orders；筛选 payment_method IN ('weixin','alipay') —— 注意业务合同中 payment_method 值为 'alipay'/'wechat'，此处按 schema_metadata 修正为 'alipay'/'wechat'；按 order_status 分组；统计 COUNT(*) 和 SUM(refund_amount) 四舍五入至2位；结果按 order_status ASC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(*) AS refund_order_count, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS total_refund_amount FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND o.payment_method IN ('alipay', 'wechat') GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY o.order_status ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出所有退款订单的订单号、订单状态、支付方式、退款原因、退款金额及对应订单的实付金额（paid_amount），要求退款金额大于订单实付金额的50%，按退款金额降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 关联 refunds（refund_status='approved'）与 orders；筛选 r.refund_amount > o.paid_amount * 0.5；返回 order_no、order_status、payment_method、refund_reason、refund_amount、o.paid_amount；按 refund_amount DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_no, o.order_status, o.payment_method, r.refund_reason, r.refund_amount, o.paid_amount FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_amount > o.paid_amount * 0.5 ORDER BY r.refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计每个退款原因下，对应的有效订单（paid/completed/shipped）中，支付方式为现金（cash）的退款订单数量及总退款金额（保留2位小数），按总退款金额降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 关联 refunds（refund_status='approved'）与 orders；筛选 order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') 且 payment_method='cash'；按 refund_reason 分组；统计 COUNT(*) 和 SUM(refund_amount) 四舍五入至2位；结果按 SUM(refund_amount) DESC 排序，LIMIT 100。
reference_sql: SELECT r.refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS cash_refund_order_count, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS total_cash_refund_amount FROM refunds r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND o.payment_method = 'cash' GROUP BY r.refund_reason ORDER BY total_cash_refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 对比2026年9月1日和2026年9月2日这两天的用户注册人数，返回日期和当日注册用户数，按日期升序排列。
intended_meaning: 统计2026-09-01与2026-09-02两天各自的用户注册人数（users.register_date），输出两行：date 和 count(*)，按 date 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT register_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users WHERE register_date IN ('2026-09-01', '2026-09-02') GROUP BY register_date ORDER BY date ASC;

question: 对比2026年8月和2026年9月上架的新品数量（products.launch_date），返回月份和当月上架产品数，按月份升序排列。
intended_meaning: 统计2026-08-01至2026-08-31、2026-09-01至2026-09-30两个完整自然月内launch_date落在该月的产品数量，输出 month（格式'YYYY-MM'）和 count，按 month 升序排列。

question: 对比2026年9月11日和2026年9月12日这两天的有效订单数（orders.order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')），返回日期和当日有效订单数，按日期升序排列。

question: 对比2026年9月第一周（9月1日至9月7日）和第二周（9月8日至9月14日）的已批准退款金额总和（refunds.refund_status='approved'），返回周区间起始日（格式'YYYY-MM-DD'）和当周退款总额，按起始日升序排列。
intended_meaning: 将2026年9月划分为两个连续7天区间：[2026-09-01,2026-09-07] 和 [2026-09-08,2026-09-14]，分别求refund_status='approved'的refund_amount之和；输出 week_start（即区间左端点）和 sum(refund_amount)，按 week_start 升序排列。
reference_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-07' THEN '2026-09-01' WHEN refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-08' AND '2026-09-14' THEN '2026-09-08' END AS week_start, SUM(refund_amount) AS sum FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' AND refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-14' GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start ASC;

question: 对比2026年第三季度（7月1日至9月30日）和2026年第二季度（4月1日至6月30日）的付费用户数（COUNT(DISTINCT orders.user_id) for valid orders），返回季度（格式'YYYY-Q'）和当季付费用户数，按季度升序排列。
intended_meaning: 统计2026-Q2（2026-04-01至2026-06-30）与2026-Q3（2026-07-01至2026-09-30）两个自然季度内valid orders对应的去重user_id数量；输出 quarter（如'2026-2'、'2026-3'）和 count，按 quarter 升序排列。

question: 对比2026年9月10日和2026年9月11日这两天的已批准退款单数（refunds.refund_status='approved'），返回日期和当日退款单数，按日期升序排列。

question: 对比2026年8月和2026年9月的有效订单总销售额（SUM(orders.paid_amount) for valid orders），返回月份和当月销售总额（保留两位小数），按月份升序排列。

question: 对比2026年9月第一日（9月1日）和最后一日（9月30日）的当日新品上架数量（products.launch_date），返回日期和当日上架产品数，按日期升序排列。

question: 对比2026年9月11日和2026年9月12日这两天的已批准退款平均单笔金额（refunds.refund_status='approved'），返回日期和当日平均退款额（保留两位小数），按日期升序排列。

question: 对比2026年9月第1周（9月1日至9月7日）和第2周（9月8日至9月14日）的付费用户数（COUNT(DISTINCT orders.user_id) for valid orders），返回周区间起始日（格式'YYYY-MM-DD'）和当周付费用户数，按起始日升序排列。

question: 列出所有注册但从未下单的用户，返回user_id、user_name、register_date，按register_date升序排列，最多100行。

question: 找出所有有订单但从未购买过‘家用电器’类商品的用户，返回user_id、user_name、city，按user_id升序排列，最多100行。

question: 列出所有上架但从未被任何有效订单购买过的商品，返回product_id、product_name、category、brand，按launch_date降序排列，最多100行。

question: 找出所有完成或已发货但未产生任何退款的订单，返回order_id、order_no、order_date、paid_amount，按order_date升序、order_id升序排列，最多100行。

question: 列出所有VIP用户中从未使用过微信支付的用户，返回user_id、user_name、city、is_vip，按city升序、user_id升序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: users.is_vip=1且其所有订单（orders.user_id匹配）的payment_method均不包含'wechat'；输出指定四列，双字段稳定排序。

question: 找出所有在2026年9月12日前注册但从未下单、也从未被退款关联过的用户，返回user_id、user_name、register_date，按register_date降序排列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: users.register_date <= '2026-09-12'，且既不在orders中出现，也不作为refunds中任意order_id对应的orders.user_id（即非退款订单发起人）；输出三列，倒序。

question: 列出所有‘食品生鲜’类商品中从未被退款过的商品，返回product_id、product_name、brand、list_price，按list_price升序排列，最多100行。

question: 找出所有使用支付宝支付但订单中未包含‘手机数码’类商品的用户，返回user_id、user_name、province，按province升序、user_id升序排列，最多100行。

question: 找出所有品牌为‘云栖’但从未出现在任何有效订单中的商品，返回product_id、product_name、category、launch_date，按launch_date升序排列，最多100行。

question: 请返回南京市用户在2026年8月的所有有效订单中，不同用户等级对应的平均订单实付金额（保留两位小数），按用户等级升序排列。

question: 请统计成都市用户在2026年9月11日至12日两天内提交的已批准退款中，各退款原因对应的退款总金额（保留两位小数），按金额降序排列。

question: 请返回食品生鲜类商品中，2026年9月12日前上架且当前在售（is_active=1）的产品名称、品牌、上市日期和销售价，按上市日期升序、销售价降序排列，最多100行。

question: 统计2026年9月12日当天，各用户等级在有效订单中使用的不同支付方式数量（去重计数），按用户等级升序排列。

question: 请返回2026年9月12日前注册、且用户等级为gold或black的用户ID、用户姓名、注册日期和是否VIP标识，按注册日期降序排列，最多100行。

question: 请列出2026年9月12日当天，退款原因为‘描述不符’且已批准的退款单号、退款金额、退款日期及对应订单的实付金额（保留两位小数），按退款金额降序排列，最多100行。

question: 列出所有上架商品中，按类别分组的平均售价与平均成本价，返回类别、平均售价、平均成本价三列，最多100行。

question: 统计各品牌在不同品类中的SKU数量，返回品牌、品类和SKU数量三列，最多100行。

question: 统计各城市付费用户数，返回城市和付费用户数两列，最多100行。

question: 统计各退款原因对应的批准退款金额，返回退款原因和批准退款金额两列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 统计在某个未明示的时间范围内（需澄清）发生的、状态为'approved'的退款，按退款原因分组汇总退款金额，结果按退款原因升序排列，仅返回退款原因和批准退款金额两列，上限100行。
ambiguity_explanation: 问题未限定退款发生时间，'各退款原因对应的批准退款金额'可指全部历史批准退款、本月批准退款、或最近7天批准退款；该refund_date区间是唯一未定要素。
ambiguity_alternatives: 2026年9月1日至2026年9月12日期间批准的退款
reference_sql: SELECT refund_reason, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS approved_refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12' AND refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_reason ORDER BY refund_reason ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 统计各品类商品的销售数量，返回品类和销售数量两列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 统计在某个未明示的时间范围内（需澄清）产生有效订单的商品行中，按品类分组的总销售数量（SUM(quantity)），结果按品类升序排列，仅返回品类和销售数量两列，上限100行。
ambiguity_explanation: 问题未说明销售行为发生时间，'各品类商品的销售数量'可指全部历史销量、最近14天销量、或参考日所在自然周销量；该order_date区间是唯一未定要素。
ambiguity_alternatives: 全部历史有效订单中的销售数量
2026年8月25日至2026年9月12日期间的销售数量

question: 统计各城市订单平均支付金额，返回城市和平均支付金额两列，最多100行。
intended_meaning: 统计在某个未明示的时间范围内（需澄清）各城市产生的有效订单的平均支付金额（AVG(paid_amount)），结果按城市升序排列，仅返回城市和平均支付金额两列，上限100行。
ambiguity_explanation: 问题未限定订单时间范围，'各城市订单平均支付金额'可指全部历史均值、本周均值、或最近8天均值；该order_date区间是唯一未定要素。
ambiguity_alternatives: 全部历史有效订单的平均支付金额
2026年9月5日至2026年9月12日期间有效订单的平均支付金额
reference_sql: SELECT u.city, ROUND(AVG(o.paid_amount), 2) AS avg_paid_amount FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-05' AND '2026-09-12' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY u.city ASC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计各退款原因在最近一段时间内批准的退款总金额，按金额降序排列，只返回退款原因和总金额两列。
intended_meaning: 统计所有已批准退款（refund_status='approved'）按refund_reason分组的sum(refund_amount)，时间范围为最近一段时间（需明确起止日），结果仅含refund_reason和SUM(refund_amount)两列，按后者降序排列。
ambiguity_explanation: 问题中‘最近一段时间’未指定具体天数或边界，存在多种合理解读：可理解为自然周（如近7天）、业务周期（如近12天覆盖当前参考日）、或完整月度（如9月1日至今）。不同选择将导致统计区间和结果显著不同。
reference_sql: SELECT refund_reason, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS sum_refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' AND refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY refund_reason ORDER BY sum_refund_amount DESC;

question: 列出过去一段时间内，各支付方式对应的已批准退款笔数及总退款金额，按退款笔数降序排列，只返回支付方式、笔数、总金额三列。
intended_meaning: 关联refunds与orders表，统计过去一段时间内refund_status='approved'的退款记录，按orders.payment_method分组，计算COUNT(*)和SUM(refund_amount)，结果仅含payment_method、COUNT、SUM三列，按COUNT降序排列。
ambiguity_explanation: ‘过去一段时间’未界定长度：可解释为固定跨度（如最近14天），也可解释为动态对齐（如上半月+当前半月），还可理解为包含全部历史但排除最新N天的‘滚动窗口’。不同解释直接影响数据覆盖范围和业务洞察粒度。
reference_sql: SELECT o.payment_method, COUNT(*) AS count_refunds, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS sum_refund_amount FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-08-25' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY o.payment_method ORDER BY count_refunds DESC;

question: 请给出过去一段时间内，各订单状态对应的有效订单数、已批准退款笔数，以及退款率（退款笔数/有效订单数），按退款率升序排列，只返回订单状态、有效订单数、退款笔数、退款率四列。
intended_meaning: 关联orders与refunds，统计过去一段时间内valid orders（order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped')）数量，及同一期间内对应订单的approved refund笔数；退款率=COUNT(approved refunds)/COUNT(valid orders)，结果仅含order_status、valid_order_count、refund_count、refund_rate四列，按refund_rate升序排列。
ambiguity_explanation: ‘过去一段时间’缺乏明确时长：可理解为参考日前推7天（2026-09-05至12），也可理解为完整工作周（如周一至周日），还可理解为业务结算周期（如每月5日至12日）。不同选择影响订单与退款匹配的完整性及比率稳定性。
reference_sql: SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS valid_order_count, COUNT(r.refund_id) AS refund_count, ROUND(COUNT(r.refund_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-05' AND '2026-09-12' AND (r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-05' AND '2026-09-12' OR r.refund_id IS NULL) GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY refund_rate ASC;

question: 请列出过去一段时间内，各商品类目下已批准退款金额占该类目对应销售金额的比例（即类目级退款率），按比例降序排列，只返回类目、退款金额、销售金额、退款率四列。
intended_meaning: 关联products-order_items-orders-refunds，统计过去一段时间内各category的approved refund_amount总和，及其对应valid order_items的item_amount总和；退款率=SUM(refund_amount)/SUM(item_amount)，结果仅含category、SUM(refund_amount)、SUM(item_amount)、退款率四列，按退款率降序排列。
ambiguity_explanation: ‘过去一段时间’未说明是否需同步对齐销售与退款时间：可要求refund_date与order_date均落在同一区间（严格同期），也可仅约束refund_date（退款发生期），或仅约束order_date（销售发生期）。三者逻辑不同，直接影响分母（销售）与分子（退款）的匹配基础。
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS sum_refund_amount, ROUND(SUM(oi.item_amount), 2) AS sum_sales_amount, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-15' AND '2026-09-12' AND (r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-08-15' AND '2026-09-12' OR r.refund_id IS NULL) GROUP BY p.category HAVING SUM(oi.item_amount) > 0 ORDER BY refund_rate DESC;

question: 请统计过去一段时间内，各城市用户的已批准退款总金额，并按金额降序排列，只返回城市和总金额两列。
intended_meaning: 关联users-orders-refunds，统计过去一段时间内refund_status='approved'的退款，按users.city分组求SUM(refund_amount)，结果仅含city和SUM(refund_amount)两列，按后者降序排列。
ambiguity_explanation: ‘过去一段时间’未指定起点：可理解为参考日倒推10天（2026-09-03至12），也可理解为当月首日至参考日（2026-09-01至12），还可理解为最近完整工作周（如2026-08-30至09-05）。不同选择导致城市维度退款分布统计偏差。
reference_sql: SELECT u.city, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS sum_refund_amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id = o.user_id JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-03' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sum_refund_amount DESC;

question: 请列出过去一段时间内，各退款原因中，使用微信支付且已批准的退款笔数及平均退款金额，按平均金额降序排列，只返回退款原因、笔数、平均金额三列。
intended_meaning: 关联refunds-orders，筛选payment_method='wechat'且refund_status='approved'的退款，按refund_reason分组，统计COUNT(*)和AVG(refund_amount)，结果仅含refund_reason、COUNT、AVG三列，按AVG降序排列。
ambiguity_explanation: ‘过去一段时间’未定义长度：可理解为参考日前推15天（2026-08-28至12），也可理解为最近两个自然周（2026-08-23至09-05），还可理解为业务高频退款周期（如促销后10天）。不同选择影响微信支付退款的代表性与时效性。
reference_sql: SELECT r.refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS count_refunds, ROUND(AVG(r.refund_amount), 2) AS avg_refund_amount FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND o.payment_method = 'wechat' AND r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-08-28' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY r.refund_reason ORDER BY avg_refund_amount DESC;

question: 请统计过去一段时间内，各品牌下已批准退款金额超过500元的退款单详情，包括退款单号、退款原因、退款金额、退款日期，按退款金额降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 关联refunds-order_items-products，筛选refund_status='approved'且refund_amount>500的记录，返回refund_no、refund_reason、refund_amount、refund_date四列，按refund_amount降序排列，LIMIT 100；时间范围为过去一段时间。
ambiguity_explanation: ‘过去一段时间’未明确是否需限定退款发生时间：可理解为仅refund_date在区间内（最直接），也可理解为要求对应订单order_date也在同一区间（强关联），还可理解为退款单创建时间created_at在区间内（非业务主时间）。三种解释对应不同数据口径。
reference_sql: SELECT r.refund_no, r.refund_reason, ROUND(r.refund_amount, 2) AS refund_amount, r.refund_date FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_amount > 500 AND r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-07' AND '2026-09-12' ORDER BY r.refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请列出过去一段时间内，各退款原因中，退款金额占对应订单实付金额超50%的退款记录，包括退款单号、订单单号、退款金额、订单实付金额，按退款金额降序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 关联refunds-orders，筛选refund_status='approved'且refund_amount > 0.5 * orders.paid_amount的记录，返回refund_no、order_no、refund_amount、paid_amount四列，按refund_amount降序排列，LIMIT 100；时间范围为过去一段时间。
ambiguity_explanation: ‘过去一段时间’未说明退款与订单时间是否需一致：可要求refund_date与order_date均落入同一区间（双重约束），也可仅约束refund_date（以退款发生为准），还可仅约束order_date（以销售发生为准）。三者导致高比例退款样本量与构成差异显著。
reference_sql: SELECT r.refund_no, o.order_no, ROUND(r.refund_amount, 2) AS refund_amount, ROUND(o.paid_amount, 2) AS paid_amount FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND r.refund_amount > 0.5 * o.paid_amount AND r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-08-20' AND '2026-09-12' ORDER BY r.refund_amount DESC LIMIT 100;

question: 请统计过去一段时间内，各退款原因中，使用现金支付且已批准的退款总金额，按金额降序排列，只返回退款原因和总金额两列。
intended_meaning: 关联refunds-orders，筛选payment_method='cash'且refund_status='approved'的退款，按refund_reason分组求SUM(refund_amount)，结果仅含refund_reason和SUM(refund_amount)两列，按后者降序排列。
ambiguity_explanation: ‘过去一段时间’未指明是否覆盖完整业务周期：可理解为参考日前推11天（2026-09-02至12），确保至少11天数据；也可理解为自然旬（9月1-10日）；还可理解为避开周末的连续工作日（如9月2-9日）。不同选择影响现金支付退款的统计完整性。
reference_sql: SELECT r.refund_reason, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS sum_refund_amount FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND o.payment_method = 'cash' AND r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-02' AND '2026-09-12' GROUP BY r.refund_reason ORDER BY sum_refund_amount DESC;

question: 请列出过去一段时间内，各退款原因中，退款日期早于订单日期的异常退款记录，包括退款单号、订单单号、退款日期、订单日期、退款金额，按退款日期升序排列，最多返回100行。
intended_meaning: 关联refunds-orders，筛选refund_status='approved'且refund_date < order_date的记录，返回refund_no、order_no、refund_date、order_date、refund_amount五列，按refund_date升序排列，LIMIT 100；时间范围为过去一段时间。

intended_meaning: 查询products表中brand='优选'且category='运动户外'，且其product_id在2026-08-01至2026-08-31期间的order_items中存在记录，且AVG(unit_price) > 200的商品，返回product_name、brand、category、avg_unit_price，按avg_unit_price DESC LIMIT 100。
ambiguity_explanation: 问题中已指定品牌（优选）、时间（2026年8月）、数值条件（平均单价>200）、聚合与排序，但'运动户外'作为category字段值未在question中显式写出，需用户确认该字符串是否为products.category列的精确值。
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.brand, p.category, ROUND(AVG(oi.unit_price), 2) AS avg_unit_price FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.brand = '优选' AND p.category = '运动户外' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' AND o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.brand, p.category HAVING AVG(oi.unit_price) > 200 ORDER BY avg_unit_price DESC LIMIT 100;
